title: Target Map Project
summary: A Django-based web application for visualizing and creating geolocated targets on an interactive Google Maps interface, backed by PostgreSQL and a REST API. The 'sdv' string appears only as a coincidental substring inside a conda package cache path in requirements.txt, with no SDV library import or usage.
needs: The 'sdv' token is part of a temp directory name in a pip file URL, unrelated to Synthetic Data Vault.
